### How Eggs Fit In

- **Gentle nutrition:** Boiled or lightly cooked eggs offer protein and key nutrients without requiring heavy digestion, as detailed on [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXI5r2hYkdihime-voHkANSUWNHk6rQamN73-BOGkTZBxYIn7_9iKOd8lelh-Vcs3qpsWp8yicfwnMzHo17bTbD7Fshihb_S-8yPEGDTwnMMqwh0wmXVniEMJsJilLBGcX0cA0z_oLuH07zahscrI).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXI5r2hYkdihime-voHkANSUWNHk6rQamN73-BOGkTZBxYIn7_9iKOd8lelh-Vcs3qpsWp8yicfwnMzHo17bTbD7Fshihb_S-8yPEGDTwnMMqwh0wmXVniEMJsJilLBGcX0cA0z_oLuH07zahscrI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXB28s132sDrwn2FoY09rZveGmd0goc-winLcs3j4Cf4UWCR-zc7tHme2QdyhYN9h4ZVdA4T45dIHthNFAe2CqdgTCiT0UnqStnJL8b26oDkImCUFghNPR8Gw9xWDjsUCjGHhjeXqLubxW_v0fvWePa3-ChM3S)
- **Pair with simple carbs:** Combining a hard-boiled egg with toast, crackers, or a bagel can be easier on a sensitive stomach than a heavy, greasy meal, according to [Houston Methodist](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-AbTIDgxJFkA0lVAb4qZtIQOGJJcchHDpnlsMVn5-MzOREZKbfBCN4wtwH3oLTrZuw9gyzJ_fhwSHC6rqVU21vZeiaih_wFzLiSkSNW244PlFQQpCCDJnvPm7Vfx90JOIVx0tFqF299WoOICEBRWrBMk_QcPYySeIc8_JPgOJr2qc1EL2NS9ICuqq2uD1SSeVnfI9h3AYoYDcMHofK56V821K7inp1EDJsT1Nhuug).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-AbTIDgxJFkA0lVAb4qZtIQOGJJcchHDpnlsMVn5-MzOREZKbfBCN4wtwH3oLTrZuw9gyzJ_fhwSHC6rqVU21vZeiaih_wFzLiSkSNW244PlFQQpCCDJnvPm7Vfx90JOIVx0tFqF299WoOICEBRWrBMk_QcPYySeIc8_JPgOJr2qc1EL2NS9ICuqq2uD1SSeVnfI9h3AYoYDcMHofK56V821K7inp1EDJsT1Nhuug)
- **Skip raw egg remedies:** Traditional drinks like a [Prairie oyster](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX7Vq8wWeOtbHpejj2spSuQG70g0nqqeLdF29jpgLuKqC52_LgqyV7JOr8K4mX65RaKJ9pQrtin4UqgxktcxKsy6bjnckjvaJBVP14VMc3_GwLVk5AzHG7-rcg5stzPNKIRd4) (often made with a raw egg, hot sauce, and seasoning) are not proven to treat hangovers and carry food-safety and nausea downsides.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX7Vq8wWeOtbHpejj2spSuQG70g0nqqeLdF29jpgLuKqC52_LgqyV7JOr8K4mX65RaKJ9pQrtin4UqgxktcxKsy6bjnckjvaJBVP14VMc3_GwLVk5AzHG7-rcg5stzPNKIRd4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXQRzwor7_VwT7ZseOC77JDQcP15RIWFij8upq7p3WBz9dEcAY5EygYdkmxv73QJIVy-15vVs4Cxdn5Lvpysx19GbVUx1uJ3t7V9A-ObV1K5S0cMyTYlS0dSHa1EkViYtV)
- **Watch heavy fats:** Greasy meats or lots of oil can slow stomach emptying and worsen nausea or reflux.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-AbTIDgxJFkA0lVAb4qZtIQOGJJcchHDpnlsMVn5-MzOREZKbfBCN4wtwH3oLTrZuw9gyzJ_fhwSHC6rqVU21vZeiaih_wFzLiSkSNW244PlFQQpCCDJnvPm7Vfx90JOIVx0tFqF299WoOICEBRWrBMk_QcPYySeIc8_JPgOJr2qc1EL2NS9ICuqq2uD1SSeVnfI9h3AYoYDcMHofK56V821K7inp1EDJsT1Nhuug)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXB28s132sDrwn2FoY09rZveGmd0goc-winLcs3j4Cf4UWCR-zc7tHme2QdyhYN9h4ZVdA4T45dIHthNFAe2CqdgTCiT0UnqStnJL8b26oDkImCUFghNPR8Gw9xWDjsUCjGHhjeXqLubxW_v0fvWePa3-ChM3S)
